description: Use for statutory, late payment, maximum, tax arrears and B2B invoice interest rates in Poland. For NBP rates only, use get_interest_rates. Polish interest rates set by law from NBP rates: statutory (capital) and late payment interest (Civil Code), maximum interest, interest on tax arrears with the reduced rate (Tax Ordinance), late payment interest in commercial transactions (B2B invoices). Each rate has the date from which it applies and the next rate (announced after an RPP decision, or the B2B rate for the next half-year: settled or a finwire.pl estimate).
name: get_statutory_interest
title: Statutory interest rates
